title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre - Stanford University on 1982-10-09
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/88.2k) -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB) Sony ECM-220T -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Fuji Metal Tape/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Excellent front‑of‑house soundboard capture of an average 1982 show, with rich, well‑balanced mix and Jerry’s above‑average vocals shining toward the end.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the recording – a close‑up FOB feed with full bass, no distortion and superb instrument balance that any audiophile would love. The performance itself is described as merely average for the era, though Jerry Garcia’s vocals are noted as better than usual, especially on the later numbers like the Estimated > segment and U.S. Blues.

ai_rating.rationale: Recording quality is rated excellent (5 stars) while show quality is average (around 3‑4 stars). Weighted 70% show + 30% recording yields a combined rating near 4.0.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Front‑of‑house (FOB) feed described as rich, full bass without boom or distortion, and well‑balanced instrument mix – an audiophile’s dream.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Generally average flow; reviewer edits out OMSN to fade in U.S. Blues for a stronger ending.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals and tone noted as better than average, half‑way decent for this period.
